section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive statistics comparing ethnic groups on demographic and body appreciation variables. Independent samples t-tests revealed no significant differences in age or BMI between ethnic groups, and no differences in marital status distribution. The Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) with 13 items was used, with a total sample mean of 3.63 (SD = .72).
